```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
codepath <- dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path)
project_root <- dirname(dirname(codepath))
datapath <- file.path(project_root, "data")
vispath <- file.path(project_root, "vis")
modelpath <- file.path(datapath, "models")

outpath <- file.path(datapath, "results_markdown", "part1_ica_vs_cca")
figpath <- file.path(vispath, "results", "part1_ica_vs_cca")
dir.create(outpath, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figpath, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

source(file.path(codepath, "data_loading_functions.R"))

settings <- list(
  sesoi_prop = params$sesoi_prop,
  methods_keep = c("ICA", "CCA"),
  clean_baseline = 1L,
  # clean = 1 is no component removed, so it is excluded from observed method counts.
  exclude_baseline_from_method_counts = TRUE,
  model_rpeak_file = file.path(modelpath, "main_all_channels.rds"),
  model_alpha_file = file.path(modelpath, "alpha_all_channels.rds")
)

safe_q <- function(x, p) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  unname(stats::quantile(x, probs = p, na.rm = TRUE))
}

safe_mean <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  mean(x)
}

safe_median <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  median(x)
}

fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  ifelse(
    is.na(x),
    "NA",
    formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits)
  )
}

fmt_pct <- function(x, digits = 1) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  ifelse(
    is.na(x),
    "NA",
    paste0(formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits), "%")
  )
}

`%||%` <- function(x, y) {
  if (is.null(x)) y else x
}

save_table <- function(x, name, csv = TRUE) {
  rds_file <- file.path(outpath, paste0(name, ".rds"))
  saveRDS(x, rds_file)
  csv_file <- NA_character_
  if (csv) {
    csv_file <- file.path(outpath, paste0(name, ".csv"))
    utils::write.csv(x, csv_file, row.names = FALSE)
  }
  tibble(name = name, rds = rds_file, csv = csv_file, n_rows = ifelse(is.data.frame(x), nrow(x), NA_integer_))
}

save_plot_both <- function(plot, name, width = 7, height = 4.5) {
  if (!isTRUE(params$save_figures)) return(invisible(NULL))
  ggsave(file.path(figpath, paste0(name, ".pdf")), plot, width = width, height = height, device = cairo_pdf)
  ggsave(file.path(figpath, paste0(name, ".png")), plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
}
```

# Analysis logic

This section compares ICA and CCA using the full 15-channel ECG configuration. 

Main decisions:

1. R-peak prominence: lower values are better.
2. Alpha power: higher values are interpreted as better signal preservation.
3. `clean == 1` is the no-cleaning baseline and is displayed as 0 components removed.
4. Observed ICA–CCA counts exclude the no-cleaning baseline, because the comparison is only meaningful after at least one component has been removed.
5. SESOI is defined separately for R-peak and alpha power as `r params$sesoi_prop * 100`% of the no-cleaning value for each participant × EEG channel.
6. Model summaries use the saved all-channel models when available. The all-channel model SESOI is the mean participant × channel baseline multiplied by `r params$sesoi_prop`.

# Load full 15-channel data

```{r load-full15-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
load_full15_metric_all_methods <- function(measure = c("rpeak", "alpha_peak")) {
  measure <- match.arg(measure)
  value_name <- measure
  methods_keep <- settings$methods_keep
  
  chlabels_data1 <- load_chlabels_dataset("sub_chlabels.mat")
  chlabels_data2 <- load_chlabels_dataset("sub_chlabels_data2.mat")
  n_data1 <- length(chlabels_data1)
  n_data2 <- length(chlabels_data2)
  participant_levels <- sprintf("P%02d", seq_len(n_data1 + n_data2))
  
  df_data1 <- load_full15_rpeak_dataset(
    data_file = "data4stats.mat",
    chlabels_by_group = chlabels_data1,
    dataset = "data1",
    offset = 0,
    methods = methods_keep,
    measure = measure,
    value_name = value_name
  )
  
  df_data2 <- load_full15_rpeak_dataset(
    data_file = "data4stats_2.mat",
    chlabels_by_group = chlabels_data2,
    dataset = "data2",
    offset = n_data1,
    methods = methods_keep,
    measure = measure,
    value_name = value_name
  )
  
  bind_rows(df_data1, df_data2) %>%
    mutate(
      dataset = as.character(dataset),
      participant = as.character(participant),
      subID = factor(subID, levels = participant_levels),
      method = factor(method, levels = c("ICA", "CCA")),
      clean = as.integer(clean),
      components_removed = clean - 1L,
      cleaning_level = factor(clean, levels = sort(unique(clean))),
      components_removed_factor = factor(components_removed, levels = sort(unique(components_removed))),
      channel = as.character(channel)
    )
}

full15_rpeak <- load_full15_metric_all_methods("rpeak")
full15_alpha <- load_full15_metric_all_methods("alpha_peak") %>%
  mutate(
    alpha_power = alpha_peak,
    alpha_power_db = if_else(alpha_power > 0, 10 * log10(alpha_power), NA_real_)
  )

manifest[["01_full15_rpeak_light"]] <- save_table(full15_rpeak, "01_full15_rpeak_light", csv = FALSE)
manifest[["01_full15_alpha_light"]] <- save_table(full15_alpha, "01_full15_alpha_light", csv = FALSE)
```

# Helper functions for observed ICA–CCA comparisons

```{r observed-helper-functions}
make_sesoi_reference <- function(df, value_col, measure_name) {
  df %>%
    filter(clean == settings$clean_baseline) %>%
    group_by(dataset, participant, channel) %>%
    summarise(
      baseline_value = mean(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      n_baseline_values = n(),
      n_methods_at_baseline = n_distinct(method),
      sesoi = settings$sesoi_prop * abs(baseline_value),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(baseline_value), is.finite(sesoi), sesoi > 0) %>%
    mutate(measure = measure_name)
}

make_observed_method_pairs <- function(df, value_col, measure_name, lower_is_better = TRUE) {
  sesoi_ref <- make_sesoi_reference(df, value_col, measure_name)
  
  df_pairs <- df %>%
    { if (settings$exclude_baseline_from_method_counts) filter(., clean != settings$clean_baseline) else . } %>%
    select(
      dataset, participant, channel, clean, components_removed,
      cleaning_level, method, value = all_of(value_col)
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(value)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = value) %>%
    filter(is.finite(ICA), is.finite(CCA)) %>%
    left_join(sesoi_ref, by = c("dataset", "participant", "channel")) %>%
    mutate(
      measure = measure_name,
      diff_cca_minus_ica = CCA - ICA,
      abs_diff_cca_minus_ica = abs(diff_cca_minus_ica),
      pct_diff_vs_ica = if_else(abs(ICA) > 0, 100 * diff_cca_minus_ica / abs(ICA), NA_real_),
      pct_reduction_vs_ica = if_else(abs(ICA) > 0, 100 * (ICA - CCA) / abs(ICA), NA_real_),
      pct_increase_vs_ica = if_else(abs(ICA) > 0, 100 * (CCA - ICA) / abs(ICA), NA_real_),
      cca_better = if (lower_is_better) diff_cca_minus_ica < 0 else diff_cca_minus_ica > 0,
      ica_better = if (lower_is_better) diff_cca_minus_ica > 0 else diff_cca_minus_ica < 0,
      within_sesoi = abs(diff_cca_minus_ica) <= sesoi,
      cca_better_by_sesoi = if (lower_is_better) diff_cca_minus_ica < -sesoi else diff_cca_minus_ica > sesoi,
      ica_better_by_sesoi = if (lower_is_better) diff_cca_minus_ica > sesoi else diff_cca_minus_ica < -sesoi,
      method_sesoi_class = case_when(
        cca_better_by_sesoi ~ "CCA better > SESOI",
        ica_better_by_sesoi ~ "ICA better > SESOI",
        TRUE ~ "similar / within SESOI"
      ),
      method_sesoi_class = factor(
        method_sesoi_class,
        levels = c("CCA better > SESOI", "similar / within SESOI", "ICA better > SESOI")
      ),
      direction = if_else(lower_is_better, "lower is better", "higher is better")
    )
  
  list(pairs = df_pairs, sesoi = sesoi_ref)
}

summarise_observed_pairs <- function(pairs) {
  pooled <- pairs %>%
    summarise(
      measure = first(measure),
      direction = first(direction),
      n_paired_observations = n(),
      n_participants = n_distinct(participant),
      n_channels = n_distinct(channel),
      pct_CCA_better = 100 * mean(cca_better, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_CCA_better_by_SESOI = 100 * mean(cca_better_by_sesoi, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_similar_within_SESOI = 100 * mean(within_sesoi, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_ICA_better_by_SESOI = 100 * mean(ica_better_by_sesoi, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_diff_CCA_minus_ICA = median(diff_cca_minus_ica, na.rm = TRUE),
      q25_diff_CCA_minus_ICA = safe_q(diff_cca_minus_ica, 0.25),
      q75_diff_CCA_minus_ICA = safe_q(diff_cca_minus_ica, 0.75),
      median_pct_diff_vs_ICA = median(pct_diff_vs_ica, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_pct_reduction_vs_ICA = median(pct_reduction_vs_ica, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_pct_increase_vs_ICA = median(pct_increase_vs_ica, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  by_participant <- pairs %>%
    group_by(measure, participant) %>%
    summarise(
      direction = first(direction),
      n_paired_observations = n(),
      n_channels = n_distinct(channel),
      pct_CCA_better = 100 * mean(cca_better, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_CCA_better_by_SESOI = 100 * mean(cca_better_by_sesoi, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_similar_within_SESOI = 100 * mean(within_sesoi, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_ICA_better_by_SESOI = 100 * mean(ica_better_by_sesoi, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_diff_CCA_minus_ICA = median(diff_cca_minus_ica, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_pct_diff_vs_ICA = median(pct_diff_vs_ica, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(measure, participant)
  
  by_components_removed <- pairs %>%
    group_by(measure, components_removed) %>%
    summarise(
      direction = first(direction),
      n_paired_observations = n(),
      n_participants = n_distinct(participant),
      n_channels = n_distinct(channel),
      pct_CCA_better = 100 * mean(cca_better, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_CCA_better_by_SESOI = 100 * mean(cca_better_by_sesoi, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_similar_within_SESOI = 100 * mean(within_sesoi, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_ICA_better_by_SESOI = 100 * mean(ica_better_by_sesoi, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_diff_CCA_minus_ICA = median(diff_cca_minus_ica, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_pct_diff_vs_ICA = median(pct_diff_vs_ica, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(measure, components_removed)
  
  by_channel <- pairs %>%
    group_by(measure, channel) %>%
    summarise(
      direction = first(direction),
      n_paired_observations = n(),
      n_participants = n_distinct(participant),
      pct_CCA_better = 100 * mean(cca_better, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_CCA_better_by_SESOI = 100 * mean(cca_better_by_sesoi, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_similar_within_SESOI = 100 * mean(within_sesoi, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_ICA_better_by_SESOI = 100 * mean(ica_better_by_sesoi, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_diff_CCA_minus_ICA = median(diff_cca_minus_ica, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_pct_diff_vs_ICA = median(pct_diff_vs_ica, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(measure, desc(pct_CCA_better_by_SESOI))
  
  class_counts <- pairs %>%
    count(measure, method_sesoi_class, name = "n") %>%
    group_by(measure) %>%
    mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  list(
    pooled = pooled,
    by_participant = by_participant,
    by_components_removed = by_components_removed,
    by_channel = by_channel,
    class_counts = class_counts
  )
}
```

# Optional model fitting

The default is not to refit models. Set `params$refit_models = TRUE` only when the saved model files are missing or need to be regenerated.

```{r optional-model-fitting, eval=params$refit_models, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
fit_metric_model <- function(df, value_col, model_file) {
  df_model <- df %>%
    filter(is.finite(.data[[value_col]])) %>%
    mutate(
      participant = droplevels(factor(participant)),
      method = factor(method, levels = c("ICA", "CCA")),
      cleaning_level = factor(clean, levels = sort(unique(clean))),
      channel = droplevels(factor(channel)),
      participant_channel = interaction(participant, channel, drop = TRUE)
    )
  
  fit <- brms::brm(
    stats::as.formula(paste0(value_col, " ~ method * cleaning_level + (1 | participant) + (1 | channel) + (1 | participant_channel)")),
    data = df_model,
    family = brms::student(),
    backend = "cmdstanr",
    chains = 4,
    iter = 4000,
    warmup = 2000,
    cores = 4,
    seed = 123,
    save_pars = brms::save_pars(all = TRUE),
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 12)
  )
  
  saveRDS(fit, model_file)
  fit
}

fit_rpeak <- fit_metric_model(full15_rpeak, "rpeak", settings$model_rpeak_file)
fit_alpha <- fit_metric_model(full15_alpha, "alpha_power", settings$model_alpha_file)
```

# Model-based ICA–CCA summaries

```{r model-helper-functions, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
make_model_sesoi <- function(df, value_col) {
  df %>%
    filter(clean == settings$clean_baseline) %>%
    group_by(dataset, participant, channel) %>%
    summarise(baseline_value = mean(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    summarise(model_sesoi = settings$sesoi_prop * mean(abs(baseline_value), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    pull(model_sesoi)
}

summarise_model_draws <- function(draws, model_sesoi, lower_is_better = TRUE, group_vars = NULL) {
  group_vars <- rlang::syms(group_vars %||% character(0))
  
  draws %>%
    group_by(!!!group_vars, contrast) %>%
    summarise(
      median = median(.value, na.rm = TRUE),
      lower95 = safe_q(.value, 0.025),
      upper95 = safe_q(.value, 0.975),
      model_sesoi = model_sesoi,
      p_CCA_lower_than_ICA = mean(.value < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      p_CCA_higher_than_ICA = mean(.value > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      p_CCA_better = if (lower_is_better) mean(.value < 0, na.rm = TRUE) else mean(.value > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      p_CCA_better_by_SESOI = if (lower_is_better) mean(.value < -model_sesoi, na.rm = TRUE) else mean(.value > model_sesoi, na.rm = TRUE),
      p_ICA_better_by_SESOI = if (lower_is_better) mean(.value > model_sesoi, na.rm = TRUE) else mean(.value < -model_sesoi, na.rm = TRUE),
      p_within_SESOI = mean(abs(.value) <= model_sesoi, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

summarise_model_method_estimates <- function(draws, group_vars = NULL) {
  group_vars <- rlang::syms(group_vars %||% character(0))
  
  draws %>%
    group_by(!!!group_vars, method) %>%
    summarise(
      median = median(.value, na.rm = TRUE),
      lower95 = safe_q(.value, 0.025),
      upper95 = safe_q(.value, 0.975),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

summarise_method_model <- function(model_file, metric_df, value_col, measure_name, lower_is_better = TRUE) {
  if (!isTRUE(params$run_model_summaries)) return(NULL)
  if (!file.exists(model_file)) return(NULL)
  
  fit <- readRDS(model_file)
  model_sesoi <- make_model_sesoi(metric_df, value_col)
  
  emm_method <- emmeans::emmeans(fit, ~ method, epred = TRUE)
  draws_method_estimates <- tidybayes::gather_emmeans_draws(emm_method)
  method_estimates <- summarise_model_method_estimates(draws_method_estimates) %>%
    mutate(measure = measure_name, posterior_scope = "overall_method_posterior") %>%
    relocate(measure, posterior_scope)
  
  contr_method <- emmeans::contrast(emm_method, method = "revpairwise")
  draws_method <- tidybayes::gather_emmeans_draws(contr_method)
  overall <- summarise_model_draws(draws_method, model_sesoi, lower_is_better) %>%
    mutate(measure = measure_name, contrast_scope = "overall") %>%
    relocate(measure, contrast_scope)
  
  emm_clean <- emmeans::emmeans(fit, ~ method | cleaning_level, epred = TRUE)
  contr_clean <- emmeans::contrast(emm_clean, method = "revpairwise")
  draws_clean <- tidybayes::gather_emmeans_draws(contr_clean)
  by_clean <- summarise_model_draws(draws_clean, model_sesoi, lower_is_better, group_vars = "cleaning_level") %>%
    mutate(
      measure = measure_name,
      contrast_scope = "by_components_removed",
      components_removed = as.integer(as.character(cleaning_level)) - 1L
    ) %>%
    select(-cleaning_level) %>%
    relocate(measure, contrast_scope, components_removed) %>%
    arrange(components_removed)
  
  # Keep posterior draws as RDS only for later diagnostics/figures.
  draws_method_file <- file.path(outpath, paste0("draws_model_", measure_name, "_contrast_overall.rds"))
  draws_method_estimates_file <- file.path(outpath, paste0("draws_model_", measure_name, "_method_posteriors_overall.rds"))
  draws_clean_file  <- file.path(outpath, paste0("draws_model_", measure_name, "_method_by_clean.rds"))
  saveRDS(draws_method, draws_method_file)
  saveRDS(draws_method_estimates, draws_method_estimates_file)
  saveRDS(draws_clean, draws_clean_file)
  
  list(
    overall = overall,
    method_estimates = method_estimates,
    by_clean = by_clean,
    model_sesoi = model_sesoi,
    draws_method_file = draws_method_file,
    draws_method_estimates_file = draws_method_estimates_file,
    draws_clean_file = draws_clean_file
  )
}
```

```{r model-rpeak-alpha, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
check_model_component_levels <- function(
    model_object,
    measure_name,
    expected_components = 0:15
) {
  if (is.null(model_object)) {
    return(tibble(
      measure = measure_name,
      n_component_levels_returned = NA_integer_,
      expected_n_component_levels = length(expected_components),
      components_returned = NA_character_,
      status = "model summary not generated"
    ))
  }
  returned <- sort(unique(model_object$by_clean$components_removed))
  tibble(
    measure = measure_name,
    n_component_levels_returned = length(returned),
    expected_n_component_levels = length(expected_components),
    components_returned = paste(returned, collapse = ","),
    status = if_else(
      setequal(returned, expected_components),
      "ok: all 0-15 component levels returned",
      "check saved model: by-clean emmeans did not return all 0-15 levels"
    )
  )
}

model_component_level_check <- bind_rows(
  check_model_component_levels(rpeak_model, "rpeak"),
  check_model_component_levels(alpha_model, "alpha_power")
)

manifest[["07_model_component_level_check"]] <- save_table(
  model_component_level_check,
  "07_model_component_level_check"
)

if (any(
  model_component_level_check$n_component_levels_returned <
    model_component_level_check$expected_n_component_levels,
  na.rm = TRUE
)) {
  warning(
    "At least one saved model did not return all component levels. ",
    "This usually means the model was fitted with cleaning_level as numeric, ",
    "or the wrong saved model file was read. Refit with cleaning_level as a factor."
  )
}
```

# Figures

```{r figure-helper-functions}
make_trajectory_plot <- function(df, value_col, ylab, title, subtitle = NULL) {
  plot_data <- df %>%
    filter(is.finite(.data[[value_col]])) %>%
    group_by(dataset, participant, method, components_removed) %>%
    summarise(value_participant = mean(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(method, components_removed) %>%
    summarise(
      n_participants = n_distinct(participant),
      mean = mean(value_participant, na.rm = TRUE),
      se = sd(value_participant, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
      median = median(value_participant, na.rm = TRUE),
      q25 = safe_q(value_participant, 0.25),
      q75 = safe_q(value_participant, 0.75),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = components_removed, y = mean, colour = method, fill = method)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.85) +
    geom_point(size = 1.8) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = method_cols) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = method_cols) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:15, limits = c(0, 15)) +
    labs(
      x = "Components removed",
      y = ylab,
      colour = "Method",
      fill = "Method",
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle
    ) +
    theme_pub
}

make_observed_class_plot <- function(pairs, title, subtitle = NULL) {
  plot_data <- pairs %>%
    count(components_removed, method_sesoi_class, name = "n") %>%
    group_by(components_removed) %>%
    mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = factor(components_removed), y = percent, fill = method_sesoi_class)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.8, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = class_cols, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      x = "Components removed",
      y = "% paired observations",
      fill = "Observed class",
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle
    ) +
    theme_pub
}

make_model_contrast_plot <- function(model_by_clean, ylab, title, subtitle = NULL) {
  if (is.null(model_by_clean)) return(NULL)
  sesoi <- unique(model_by_clean$model_sesoi)
  sesoi <- sesoi[is.finite(sesoi)][1]
  
  ggplot(model_by_clean, aes(x = components_removed, y = median)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.35, colour = cca_pal$zero) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(-sesoi, sesoi), linewidth = 0.30, linetype = "dashed", colour = cca_pal$mid_grey) +
    geom_line(colour = cca_pal$method[["CCA"]], linewidth = 0.55) +
    geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = lower95, ymax = upper95), colour = cca_pal$method[["CCA"]], linewidth = 0.55) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:15, limits = c(0, 15)) +
    labs(
      x = "Components removed",
      y = ylab,
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle
    ) +
    theme_pub
}

make_model_contrast_density_plot <- function(model_object, xlab, title, subtitle = NULL) {
  if (is.null(model_object)) return(NULL)
  if (!file.exists(model_object$draws_method_file)) return(NULL)
  draws <- readRDS(model_object$draws_method_file)
  sesoi <- model_object$model_sesoi
  summary_row <- model_object$overall %>% slice(1)
  
  ggplot(draws, aes(x = .value)) +
    geom_density(fill = cca_pal$light_grey, colour = cca_pal$dark_grey, alpha = 0.65, linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = cca_pal$zero, linewidth = 0.45) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-sesoi, sesoi), colour = cca_pal$mid_grey, linewidth = 0.35, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = summary_row$median, colour = cca_pal$method[["CCA"]], linewidth = 0.8) +
    labs(
      x = xlab,
      y = "Posterior density",
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle
    ) +
    theme_pub
}

make_model_method_posterior_plot <- function(model_object, xlab, title, subtitle = NULL) {
  if (is.null(model_object)) return(NULL)
  if (!file.exists(model_object$draws_method_estimates_file)) return(NULL)
  draws <- readRDS(model_object$draws_method_estimates_file) %>%
    mutate(method = factor(method, levels = c("ICA", "CCA")))
  estimates <- model_object$method_estimates %>%
    mutate(method = factor(method, levels = c("ICA", "CCA")))
  
  ggplot(draws, aes(x = .value, fill = method, colour = method)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.28, linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(
      data = estimates,
      aes(xintercept = median, colour = method),
      linewidth = 0.8,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = estimates,
      aes(x = lower95, xend = upper95, y = -Inf, yend = -Inf, colour = method),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 2.2,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = method_cols) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = method_cols) +
    labs(
      x = xlab,
      y = "Posterior density",
      fill = "Method",
      colour = "Method",
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_pub
}
```

# Main result sentence stubs

```{r sentence-stubs}
get_row1 <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || nrow(x) == 0) return(NULL)
  x %>% slice(1)
}

make_observed_sentence <- function(row, metric_label, better_word) {
  if (is.null(row)) {
    return(paste0("Observed ", metric_label, " method counts were not generated."))
  }
  sprintf(
    "Across %s paired full 15-channel observations excluding the no-cleaning baseline, CCA showed %s than ICA in %s of observations and by more than the participant × EEG-channel SESOI in %s of observations; %s were practically similar and ICA was better by more than SESOI in %s. The median CCA minus ICA difference was %s.",
    format(row$n_paired_observations, big.mark = ","),
    better_word,
    fmt_pct(row$pct_CCA_better, 1),
    fmt_pct(row$pct_CCA_better_by_SESOI, 1),
    fmt_pct(row$pct_similar_within_SESOI, 1),
    fmt_pct(row$pct_ICA_better_by_SESOI, 1),
    fmt_num(row$median_diff_CCA_minus_ICA, 3)
  )
}

make_rpeak_model_sentence <- function(model) {
  if (is.null(model)) {
    return("The all-channel Bayesian model summary for R-peak prominence was not generated because the saved model file was unavailable.")
  }
  row <- model$overall %>% slice(1)
  sprintf(
    "In the all-channel Bayesian model, the posterior CCA minus ICA contrast for R-peak prominence was %s [central 95%% interval %s, %s], with P(CCA < ICA) = %s and P((CCA - ICA) < -SESOI) = %s.",
    fmt_num(row$median, 3),
    fmt_num(row$lower95, 3),
    fmt_num(row$upper95, 3),
    fmt_num(row$p_CCA_lower_than_ICA, 3),
    fmt_num(row$p_CCA_better_by_SESOI, 3)
  )
}

make_alpha_model_sentence <- function(model) {
  if (is.null(model)) {
    return("The all-channel Bayesian model summary for alpha power was not generated because the saved model file was unavailable.")
  }
  row <- model$overall %>% slice(1)
  sprintf(
    "In the all-channel Bayesian model, the posterior CCA minus ICA contrast for alpha power was %s [central 95%% interval %s, %s], with P(CCA > ICA) = %s, P(|CCA - ICA| <= SESOI) = %s, and P(CCA higher by more than SESOI) = %s.",
    fmt_num(row$median, 3),
    fmt_num(row$lower95, 3),
    fmt_num(row$upper95, 3),
    fmt_num(row$p_CCA_higher_than_ICA, 3),
    fmt_num(row$p_within_SESOI, 3),
    fmt_num(row$p_CCA_better_by_SESOI, 3)
  )
}
```

# Manifest

```{r manifest, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
manifest_df <- bind_rows(manifest)
manifest_public <- manifest_df %>%
  mutate(
    rds = if_else(is.na(rds), NA_character_, basename(rds)),
    csv = if_else(is.na(csv), NA_character_, basename(csv))
  )
manifest[["99_manifest"]] <- save_table(manifest_public, "99_manifest")

cat("Manifest saved as 99_manifest.rds and 99_manifest.csv.\n")

if (isTRUE(params$show_manifest)) {
  kable(manifest_public)
}
```
